The shelf table will look like this:

idnamelocation
1FictionNorth Wing
2MapsReading Room Two

To link them, each book stores the ID of its shelf in shelf_id:

from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass
class Shelf:
    shelf_id: int | None = None
    book_ids: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
